Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Aarav - 11 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Pallavi - 36 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Sharda - 74 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Pallavi stands near him.]

Aarav: "What lovely weather!"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Aarav (softly): "Exactly right."

[Aarav feeds the dog.]

Aarav: "Careful!"

[Aarav milks the cow.]

Aarav: "That was such a fun day!"
